postconditions.expression: output is not 'Impossible' or output is 'Impossible' and input.T == 1
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Impossible', the input must be a single test case with T=1.
If the output is not 'Impossible', the first number in the output is the maximum profit Chef can gain.
If the output is not 'Impossible', the second number in the output is the minimum total cost of the chosen roads that yields the maximum profit.

invariants.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 5.
The number of cities N is between 2 and 5000.
The number of road proposals by other companies M1 is between 1 and 20000.
The number of road proposals by Chef's company M2 is between 1 and 20000.

invariants.expression: all(input.roads_other[i][0] != input.roads_other[i][1] for i in range(input.M1))
invariants.description: No road proposal connects a city to itself.

invariants.expression: all(input.roads_chef[i][0] != input.roads_chef[i][1] for i in range(input.M2))
invariants.description: No road proposal by Chef's company connects a city to itself.

invariants.expression: all(0 <= input.roads_other[i][2] <= 1000000000 for i in range(input.M1))
invariants.description: The cost of each road proposal by other companies is between 0 and 1000000000.

invariants.expression: all(0 <= input.roads_chef[i][2] <= 1000000000 for i in range(input.M2))
invariants.description: The cost of each road proposal by Chef's company is between 0 and 1000000000.
